review_candidates.description: Engineering Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. As our Platform Engineering Manager, you will lead our Cloud Platform and SRE teams, taking charge of the technical foundation and reliability that allows Prolific to scale securely and efficiently. Why Prolific At Prolific, our product development group is a powerhouse of Engineering, Platform, Product, Data, Design, and Research – all working in lockstep. You'll thrive in cross-functional teams, each with a clear mission and the freedom to self-organize and innovate towards the best possible outcomes. We're passionate about moving fast and continuously improving, and we champion strong engineering principles and a culture of strong ownership. As a Senior Platform Engineering Manager, you've built deep technical credibility as a senior individual contributor, solving complex infrastructure and business problems firsthand,before progressing into building high-performing teams and raising the bar through structured management practices. Your expertise will directly impact the technical excellence of your teams' work. You'll be instrumental in driving technical decision-making and collaboratively building scalable, resilient, and maintainable systems that power the future of AI. What you'll be doing Unified Leadership: Provide leadership, coaching, and professional growth opportunities for one or more Platform teams, fostering a culture of high performance and ownership. Infrastructure Ownership: Drive the strategic direction for our infrastructure and platform ensuring robust management of our services like Kubernetes (GKE) clusters. Focus on continuous improvement, operational excellence, and innovation. Champion SRE Culture: Own availability and embed SRE principles across the organization, including defining SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, and enhancing observability and incident remediation. Platform & Developer Experience: Own the developer-facing platform — golden paths, self-service infrastructure, and internal tooling — so teams can provision, deploy, and operate services safely and independently. Treat the platform as a product with its own roadmap and adoption metrics, not just a set of shared services. Security and Compliance: Ensure our cloud environments remain secure and compliant with standards such as SOC2 and ISO-27001. What you'll bring Infrastructure Leadership: Proven experience leading teams in the infrastructure and SRE domains, with a track record of scaling platforms and people. Technical Expertise: Several years of deep expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Terragrunt, Crossplane), with GitOps workflows using tools like ArgoCD. Reliability & Architecture: Solid understanding of complex infrastructure and application architecture, observability principles, and incident management. Stability & Velocity: Experience balancing the need for platform stability and reliability with the goal of increasing developer productivity and velocity. Bridge Builder: Fluency in translating complex technical solutions and their feasibility into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical stakeholders. Our Technology Stack (You'll be working with these technologies): Cloud Platforms: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS) Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Terragrunt, Crossplane Programming Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript Frameworks: Django Rest Framework, container-based services, Serverless architectures Databases: MongoDB, Postgres, ElasticSearch, and DynamoDB DevOps & Monitoring Tools: CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, Celery, EventBridge, DataDog Join us at Prolific and play a critical role in shaping the human data infrastructure that is powering the next generation of AI innovation. Apply now and let's build the future, together. Why is Prolific a great place to work We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity. Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture. Links to more information on Prolific Benefits External Handbook Website Youtube Privacy Statement By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal information.

review_candidates.title: Projects Director
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose : To lead and take end-to-end accountability for project delivery performance globally — from order award through final completion, protecting project margin and ensuring on-time, on-quality delivery in line with the Target Operating Model, so that the organisation converts awarded contracts into profitable, reliable outcomes for clients and the business. DIMENSIONS Key Accountabilities / Performance Measures: Lead, develop and execute project delivery strategy • Owns end-to-end value stream performance — bid margin through final delivery cost — ensuring commercial outcomes are protected across the full project lifecycle rather than managed in isolated stages. • Translates awarded contracts into executable delivery plans across the global portfolio, ensuring award assumptions convert into deliverable, resourced execution plans. • Sets global scheduling standards and delivery cadence across the project portfolio, ensuring consistent planning discipline and comparability of delivery performance across projects. • Monitors and reports project margin at completion vs. award, providing early visibility of margin erosion so corrective action can be taken before final completion. • Identifies delivery risks across the project portfolio and drives mitigation actions, reducing the likelihood and impact of delivery failures on cost, schedule or client satisfaction. • Drives continuous improvement in project delivery methodology and tools, raising the consistency and efficiency of delivery execution across the organisation over time. Order-to-Cash & EPC Interface • Owns the end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) process from contract award through to delivery completion, ensuring revenue is recognised and collected in line with contractual milestones rather than delayed by disconnected handovers. • Acts as the primary interface with EPC contractors and clients on schedule, scope and technical delivery matters, ensuring delivery commitments are aligned and disputes are resolved before they impact project outcomes. • Tracks and actions milestone achievement and invoicing triggers, ensuring cash conversion keeps pace with physical progress and working capital is protected. • Coordinates with Finance (Treasury & Credit) on billing and collections milestones, ensuring collections risk is identified early and resolved in partnership with Finance rather than surfacing as a delivery-side surprise. Change Control & Claims Management • Establishes and governs change control processes across all active projects, ensuring scope, cost and schedule variations are captured and approved consistently rather than left to ad-hoc handling. • Owns claims management strategy, including identification, documentation and negotiation, securing fair commercial recovery on entitled claims and protecting the company's contractual position with clients and EPC partners. • Drives disciplined variation and claims governance, protecting project margin from erosion due to unmanaged scope creep or unresolved commercial exposure. Global Scheduling & Delivery Cadence • Owns the global project schedule and portfolio-level delivery prioritisation, ensuring resources and priorities are sequenced to protect on-time delivery across the global portfolio. • Facilitates the weekly delivery control / monthly S&OP cadence, aligning demand, capacity, supply and delivery priorities to keep the global portfolio synchronised and prevent conflicting local decisions. • Maintains live action logs and drives decisions through the cadence rather than bilateral escalation, ensuring delivery issues are resolved transparently and consistently across the organisation. • Escalates and resolves cross-country / cross-function delivery conflicts, protecting portfolio-level delivery commitments over individual country or functional interests.
